items.title: Synthetic hearth-sector verification draft
items.observation: When one hearth sector warms but cooling flow appears normal, I watch for persistence across taps and slower cooling after a tap.
items.recommendedCheck: I compare the sector with neighboring shell thermocouples and check cooling-water inlet and outlet temperature and recent flow history, not only the current flow. I validate sensor health and recent calibration, and request a cooling-circuit inspection and ultrasound measurement when the signals agree.
items.rationale: A single reading can mislead; corroboration lowers the chance of reacting to an instrument fault.
items.safetyBoundary: A new operator must never bypass alarms or change furnace or cooling controls without engineering approval.
